notes: Table 2 reports numbers of patients (%), not episodes. The extracted Any adverse event row is within the permanent-discontinuation section. Its first numeric column is Liraglutide (N = 4668) and its second is Placebo (N = 4672); the verbatim XML row spans preserve this column order because arm labels occur in separate table headers. Percentages are printed as 9.5 and 7.3 under the no. of patients (%) heading. The same section separately reports serious adverse events (192 and 245) and severe adverse events (164 and 188), which are narrower outcomes. The window is the overall trial follow-up; the table describes events reported during the trial.
